entries.summary: I just wanted to do a quick email today to stress to you the importance of testing your offers.
entries.body:
Hey it’s Max from The Inbox Newsletter.

I just wanted to do a quick email today to stress to you the importance of testing your offers.

Attached below is an A/B test we recently ran for a brand of ours…

We tested **two different offers for a Winback flow email** (someone bought 4 months ago and hasn’t purchased since).

To bring these people back, they were running an offer.

We decided to A/B test the offer.

Some people respond differently to different offers, especially at different parts of the customer journey.

People who have never bought before may be more inclined to buy from simple $ OFF or % OFF to try out your products.

Whereas past purchasers may be more inclined to buy off of a bundle offer, or a free gift, or some sort of store credit.

We tested two offers for this client.

Here are the results:

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/c823ea96-0966-4376-a634-c55f1b2bee25/Screenshot_2025-08-29_at_12.21.25_PM.png?t=1756462891)

AB Test Results

**Top Option:**
**- Open Rate:** 51.4%
**- Click Rate:** 0.85
**- Placed Orders:** 1 placed order

**Bottom Option:**
**- Open Rate:** 52.88%
**- Click Rate:** 5.77% (6.8x increase in click rate)
**- Placed Orders:** 10 (10x placed orders)

Insane results that will result in a much higher LTV for their customers now that we know this info and will keep this offer live.

TEST YOUR OFFERS.

Don’t just throw out a 10% off and use it blindly.

Use 10% off, test it vs other offers, and move forward with the winners.

**BONUS TIP**

Black Friday is coming… and you want to make sure your offer is the highest converting for your audience.

Choose a small part of your audience during Labor Day to test a couple different offers that you may run for BFCM.

Whatever offer wins, run that kind of offer for BFCM 😉

If you want a team that is setting up these tests for you and getting the most out of your email channel, book a call with us _[**here »**](https://calendly.com/maxwellcopy/discovery-meeting?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=don-t-just-throw-out-10-off-test-your-offers-10x-placed-order-increase-examples)_

entries.title: How Brez Kept Their BFCM Sales Going for 6 Weeks Straight
entries.summary: Black Friday is coming up VERY fast (93 days)… and you must be getting your offers locked in now.
entries.body:
Hey it’s Max from The Inbox Newsletter.

Black Friday is coming up VERY fast (93 days)… and you must be getting your offers locked in now.

Most brands blast 20% off and hope for the best on Black Friday.

But today I want to show what one of the top brands leading the ecom space right now did last year.

Let’s break down the exact offer that crushed for [Brez](https://www.drinkbrez.com/?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=how-brez-kept-their-bfcm-sales-going-for-6-weeks-straight) last year (and how you can swipe it).

**Key Takeaways:**

- Brez extended their BFCM period into a 6-week push using layered offers.

- They built urgency and momentum early with store credit + a giveaway.

- BFCM weekend had a stronger CTA with credit stacking and free shipping.

- They leaned into holiday gifting and party bundles to boost AOV post BFCM.

- Offers were repackaged for New Year’s, keeping sales flowing even after Christmas.

### Phase 1: Warm Up With a Bonus + Hype

**🗓️ Nov 12–28**

Before most brands even launched, Brez was already driving conversions.

Their first offer they warmed up with the best offer of the year…

**$15 store credit + entry into a lifetime supply giveaway** for any purchase.

**Why this worked:**

- Store credit seems higher perceived value than $15 OFF… as it implies the person already has the $15 and they don’t want to lose it

- The giveaway created urgency to not wait to buy…

- They got two bites at the apple, early buyers who’d also return later for BFCM

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/60bf53c7-b5a6-4021-a52d-e513f3f6d7a3/screencapture-milled-drinkbrez-com-this-is-our-biggest-offer-ever-KedAnFBZNaTgtys2-2025-08-05-11_29_10-edit__1_.png?t=1756303651)

Early Access Nov 12–28

### Phase 2: BFCM Weekend — Stackable Perks

**🗓️ Nov 29–Dec 3**

When the real BFCM period hit, Brez leveled up their offer.

**$25 store credit + free shipping over $100**

Crazy offer.

**Why this worked:**

- $25 is a higher perceived value than a 20% off coupon

- Free shipping pushed AOVs over the $100 mark

- Messaging was simple, clear, and high-urgency

- Best offer of the period saved for BFCM

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/9575952d-6855-47c2-96f8-06cadf3a7375/screencapture-milled-drinkbrez-com-save-25-bfcm-is-here-g8-OCwdMyxlRr-bP-2025-07-31-13_23_57-edit__1_.png?t=1756303722)

BFCM Nov 29–Dec 3

### Phase 3: Holiday Bundles Built for Gifting

**🗓️ Dec 9–13**
As shipping deadlines for Christmas crept closer, Brez launched limited holiday bundles — up to $180 off.

These were clearly framed as gifts and party essentials which ties their product to a use case. “Perfect for your Secret Santa”… “Take these to the Christmas party”

**Why this worked:**

- Bundles boosted AOV

- The holiday framing made it feel relevant (not just another discount)

- Offers hit when gifting intent peaked

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/a7d2fc1e-9fb4-4c54-b95a-81d9d456f347/Screenshot-2025-08-05-at-11.29.47-AM.png?t=1756303793)

Gifting Dec 9–13

### Phase 4: Reuse Holiday Offers for NYE

**🗓️ Dec 21–31**

Brez wasn’t done.

They _repurposed_ those same holiday bundles with a New Year’s spin.

Same product, different angle: **“Stock up for your NYE party”**

**Why this worked:**

- Extended the revenue window into late December

- Kept conversion momentum alive after Christmas

- No new creative needed, just repackaging

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/27e4b5c2-8ee4-4445-a849-ce4570e18cf7/Screenshot_2025-08-27_at_4.11.19_PM.png?t=1756303883)

Dec 21–31

#### Final Thoughts

Brez didn’t just run a 20% OFF offer on Black Froday and Cyber Monday…

They mapped out a 6-week content + offer calendar that layered urgency, incentives, and smart positioning to turn Q4 into a high-margin growth machine.

Make sure you do the same by stacking different offers for different periods of the season to make the most of the urgency.

If you want me to map out your Q4 blueprint for free, _**[book a call with us here »](https://calendly.com/maxwellcopy/discovery-meeting?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=how-brez-kept-their-bfcm-sales-going-for-6-weeks-straight)**_

entries.title: Why Your Ads Are About to Eat Your Profit Alive in Q4
entries.summary: Let’s not sugarcoat it: Q4 is coming, and it’s about to be a profit bloodbath for brands depending on ads to carry them through.
entries.body:
Hey it’s Max from The Inbox Newsletter.

Let’s not sugarcoat it: Q4 is coming, and it’s about to be a profit bloodbath for brands depending on ads to carry them through.

If you’re not doubling down on email and SMS now, you’re in for a long Q4…

**Key Takeaways:**

- Q4 ad costs are about to skyrocket, every year Q4 CPMs rise

- Relying solely on paid traffic for BFCM is the most expensive game in ecom.

- Your owned channels (email & SMS) are your only real profit levers this quarter.

- List size, warmth, and strategy will decide if you thrive or survive.

### The Paid Ads Profit Problem

Every Q4, the same thing happens:

More competition → Skyrocketing CPMs → Declining ROAS → Large discounts on your products → Slashed margins → Sexy revenue numbers but sh*tty profit numbers

And yet most brands keep playing this losing game, dumping thousands into ads that barely break even (if that) once you factor in discounts.

Here’s the truth of the ecom funnel:

Paid ads _acquire_ traffic.

Email and SMS profitably _monetize_ that traffic.

And in Q4, only one of those is affordable.

**Just look at the rise of CPMs in Q4 last year…**

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/526010db-492f-45d1-8b03-c34ae93aafb1/CPM-by-industry-1024x651__2_.png?t=1756116997)

2024 Q4 Meta CPMs

### Email & SMS = Your Profit Engine

If you're looking for a high-ROI channel that doesn't break when the ad auction heats up, it's your owned list.

Let’s do the math:

- Email averages 41x ROI.

- SMS converts 5310% higher than cold traffic.

- Open rates on SMS = ~98%

- CPMs are essentially $0.

One of our client brands below made 62% of their **November revenue from email alone** on a $3,000/month Klaviyo bill.

That’s a 195x ROI. Try pulling that from Meta.

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/1df85f06-3f88-49ea-a7bb-5e5d50f9c184/Screenshot-2025-07-21-at-11.53.34-AM__3_.png?t=1756117056)

### What to Do NOW If You Want to Be Profitable This Q4

This is your playbook if you want to come out of BFCM with cash in your pocket:

#### 1. Stack Your List-ASAP

Paid traffic is fine _if_ you convert it into owned traffic. Optimize your pop-up forms and drive cold visitors into email/SMS sequences that convert. If you aren’t capturing 8–10% of site visitors into email/sms subs, you’re burning budget.

#### 2. Warm The List Up

Multiple campaigns per week. Campaigns with purpose. Pre-BFCM education, brand storytelling, social proof. Hit every angle now, so your audience is primed to buy before your sale even drops.

#### 3. Build Your Offer Calendar

You need strong, distinct offers for:

- Early Access

- Black Friday

- Cyber Monday

- Holiday Gifting

Your email/SMS campaign calendar should be **done and scheduled by October** so you can prep and get your marketing materials ready.

### Last Word: If You Want Profit This Q4… Don’t Depend on Ads

The most dangerous thing you can do is assume this year will be like last year.
Ad platforms are more expensive. Consumers are more skeptical. Margins are thinner.

Email and SMS are the **last profit levers** you control.

I made a video with Jackson Blackledge (Google Ads expert) breaking down **How to Win BFCM Before It Even Starts…** [watch the video here »](https://youtu.be/iBg8j_U_6oY?si=WixkjDVYnit2laPH&utm_source=www.inboxnewsletter.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=why-your-ads-are-about-to-eat-your-profit-alive-in-q4)

**Get Your Free Custom Q4 Playbook**

I’m personally running free audits and giving Q4 gameplans to brands above $50k/mo who book a call with us below.

Claim yours before I go insane with the amount of Q4 analysis I will be doing.

entries.title: How I Would Add $1M In Revenue to Crocs This Year
entries.summary: Most ecommerce brands are bleeding money from the dumbest spots and they don’t even realize it.
entries.body:
Hey it’s Max from The Inbox Newsletter.

Most ecommerce brands are bleeding money from the dumbest spots and they don’t even realize it.

I don’t work with Crocs… but if I did? They might owe me a million bucks.

I mocked up some form and email improvements for fun, and just these hypothetical changes alone could drive serious revenue.

Here’s the breakdown.

**Key Takeaways:**

- A poorly optimized pop-up form is silently killing your list growth and revenue.

- Bad email design = low clicks = lost sales.

- Buttons need to be big, bold, and above the fold

- A fresh, fun approach to your email copy will drive higher engagement and ROI.

## Come On Guys…

Crocs (like most big brands) are missing low-hanging fruit.

I have sympathy for smaller brands who have low-hanging fruit… you know you’re a bust founder and have a million things you’re working on.

But for massive brands with millions of site visitors every month, even improving some metric by 10% can result in 7-figures at the end of the year.

Big brands… do better!

## What’s Wrong With This Pop-Up Form?

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/a75ed94b-f586-4d0b-858f-439fd798d02a/Screenshot_2025-08-06_at_1.06.35_PM.png?t=1755518627)

Crocs Current Pop-Up Form

Few things wrong with this form.

For one, they give a 15% discount… but it’s buried and no one will see it.

You can barely see it, and the call-to-action is forgettable. That little “X” in the top right is also the escape route users instinctively tap without even seeing the offer.

You don’t want to lead with “be the first to know”… that benefit is not nearly as strong as 15% OFF.

We had to make some modern changes to it.

Here’s the _mock_ version I made to fix it:

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/dabfd278-980e-4f74-8506-74049e581797/Screenshot_2025-08-18_at_2.08.41_PM.png?t=1755518928)

Step 1 and Step 2

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/1427c04b-adbc-4c20-80a9-f0b1a83e53f5/Screenshot_2025-08-18_at_2.09.11_PM.png?t=1755518956)

Step 3 and Step 4

**Key Changes:**

- **Clear headline:** “You’ve got 15% off” — instantly visible

- **Strategic UX:** Moved the close button to the top left so people don’t auto move their thumb and cancel in the top right corner (pattern break)

- **Question first:** A fun “quiz” feel that engages users before asking for commitment getting them to start the process

- **Two-step conversion:** Email, then SMS for max opt-ins

- **Urgency cue:** “Finish signing up to activate your discount” feels actionable

**I can guarantee this would convert at minimum 2x the number of people.**

That means 2x the email list… **and over the long run 2x the email revenue.**

### A Better Email for a Better Brand Experience

Their current email designs are a snoozefest. Small button, bad placement, no personality.

My mock redesign focused on:

- **Above-the-fold CTA:** Big, bold button up top (especially on mobile)

- **Relatable copy:** “Don’t forget your Crocs” from Mom

- **Smart product descriptions:** “Classic clog — easy on/off when you’re late to class”

- **Hierarchy in layout:** Showcase products, support benefits, and a final CTA that’s impossible to miss

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/f881517d-b6c5-4fdb-8600-fdbc46a0105b/screencapture-milled-Crocs-dorm-drop-incoming-ZJz0s82wXernmxqO-2025-08-06-13_02_52-edit__1_.png?t=1755519095)

Email Before

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/25dcda64-a7f3-4e2b-9086-357686c8b9f1/CROCS.png?t=1755519154)

Email After

### Estimated Upside Is Huge.

If Crocs — or any brand making these same mistakes — implemented this type of strategy, here’s what I estimate:

- **2x list growth from the pop-up alone**

- **25%+ improvement in email conversion rates**

- **Compounded over a year that crosses easily 7 figures extra**

entries.title: The $500M Funnel Dissected: What ButcherBox Gets Right (That You May Not)
entries.summary: How does a DTC meat brand convince total strangers to drop hundreds on a year’s worth of beef, chicken, and pork?
entries.body:
Hey it’s Max from The Inbox Newsletter.

How does a DTC meat brand convince total strangers to drop hundreds on a year’s worth of beef, chicken, and pork?

They cracked the funnel code.

And no, it’s not about the meat… it’s about how they _sell_ the meat.

**Key Takeaways:**

- ButcherBox turns a standard 10% discount into a more appealing framing of “Free Meat for a Year” hook.

- Their quiz-based lead capture maximizes engagement and converts

- Email and SMS sequences hammer home frequency at almost zero marginal cost.

- Text-based emails from a person make the pitch feel personal and perform incredibly well.

- They shift the high CAC from Meta ads into low-cost retention via email/SMS.

## Quick Context

[ButcherBox](http://www.butcherbox.com/?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=the-500m-funnel-dissected-what-butcherbox-gets-right-that-you-may-not) is one of the biggest subscription food brands in DTC.

They’ve scaled to over $500M/year, and their secret weapon is a high-performing customer acquisition funnel built around one thing: _email and SMS_.

Their strategy is a textbook case on **how to front-load Meta ad spend and convert cold traffic profitably through owned channels.**

Here’s the breakdown...

### 1. The Offer Framing Is Elite

Most brands lead with a 10% off discount.

ButcherBox reframes their offer as “Get Free Meat for a Year.”

It comes out as the same cost on their end… you get 10 meats and 1 of them comes free every month.

So they could say 10% OFF… but nope. Reframed as free meat.

Same monetary value. Completely different perceived value.

**They understood that** **_how_** **you say something matters more than** **_what_** **you're saying.**

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/942f3f5f-4c95-40f0-9cfd-c40523ef1cc8/Screenshot_2025-08-15_at_12.17.38_PM.png?t=1755253064)

### 2. Engagement Starts With a Quiz

Instead of just throwing you onto a product page, they pull you in with a quiz.

It’s educational, but also subtly persuasive.

Every answer leads to: “Hey, we’re exactly what you need.”

And you can’t claim the offer without giving your email. Beautiful.

You can go through it here:

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/7f47d15b-df44-4264-88ac-84ea9af54b71/Screenshot_2025-08-15_at_12.22.06_PM.png?t=1755253330)

Ad Lander Page

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e4a0fbef-6057-4af2-9ac0-9695ab616ffb/Screenshot_2025-08-15_at_12.19.21_PM.png?t=1755253166)

Question 1

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/a7a63525-e4fd-432f-82c7-4b1532a97e68/Screenshot_2025-08-15_at_12.20.50_PM.png?t=1755253255)

Answer 1

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/c68cc185-8663-42e3-9b63-86f0b58ccc4e/Screenshot_2025-08-15_at_12.21.55_PM.png?t=1755253319)

Success Page Email Opt-In After 4 Questions

### 3. They Send A LOT Of Emails / SMS

Once they have your email you’re getting with value-packed, high-frequency emails.

- Offer in the hero section

- Educational blocks below

- Micing in personal plain text emails

Frequency is the key here… they aren’t scared to get send daily and be aggressive with their offers.

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/90eeeae5-7e0b-4a4f-b0a3-7a00affab462/Screenshot_2025-08-15_at_12.24.26_PM.png?t=1755253470)

Email Sending Structure

### 4. SMS Is Their Secret Sauce

SMS backs up email with sends multiple times per week.

Short, punchy reminders: “Your free meat is waiting.”

They don’t reinvent the wheel. They just make sure the wheel hits you _again_ and _again_.

### 5. The Shift CAC from Paid to Owned Channels

This is the real brilliance:

They _accept_ high acquisition costs from Meta… but immediately recoup it through email/SMS where it’s cheap.

Once you opt-in, they no longer rely on $20 CPCs.

Now they can hit you with message that cost pennies until you finally convert.

### Conclusion

ButcherBox is running a masterclass in owned-channel retention.

Their funnel isn’t magic. It’s just well-built:

- Grab attention with a killer hook

- Pull in emails with an educational quick quiz

- Blitz with cheap, personalized messaging

And suddenly, they’ve turned cold strangers into long-term subscribers.

Steal this structure. Because this is how modern DTC wins.

My team of $100M marketers build these funnels for a living. Book a call to see what we can do for you: _**[Learn More »](https://calendly.com/maxwellcopy/discovery-meeting?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=the-500m-funnel-dissected-what-butcherbox-gets-right-that-you-may-not)**_

entries.title: Ecommerce Black Friday / Cyber Monday 2025... Q4 Prep
entries.summary: If you nail BFCM, you ride the revenue wave into the new year. If you miss… you’re stuck playing catch-up for months.
entries.body:
Hey it’s Max from The Inbox Newsletter.

For most ecommerce brands, Q4 is a big deal.

If you nail BFCM, you ride the revenue wave into the new year. If you miss… you’re stuck playing catch-up for months.

Here’s the part nobody tells you: Your Q4 results have almost nothing to do with what you do in November.

The winners start winning in August.

**Key Takeaways:**

- Your Black Friday/Cyber Monday results are determined by what you do in August–October, not November.

- The cheapest, highest ROI leads come from Q3 and early Q4 email / sms list building, not cold ads in Q4.

- Email/SMS convert 5–10x higher than cold traffic, so growing these lists early is your #1 priority.

- Use high-intent Google search + pre-sale campaigns to build your list at a fraction of November costs.

- Optimize pop-ups for commitment bias and double opt-ins to hit 10%+ conversion rates.

I teamed up with the Google Ads GOAT, [Jackson Blackledge](https://x.com/blvckledge?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=ecommerce-black-friday-cyber-monday-2025-q4-prep), on a BFCM prep guide and YouTube video to share how we break BFCM records every year.

I’m going to summarize what we talked about in this newsletter.

You can watch the full video / guide _**[here »](https://youtu.be/iBg8j_U_6oY?si=b6kvNrpfsSWuQyEb&utm_source=www.inboxnewsletter.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ecommerce-black-friday-cyber-monday-2025-q4-prep)**_

## Background: Why BFCM is Won Before It Starts

Black Friday/Cyber Monday is the Super Bowl of ecommerce. For many brands, this single weekend can account for **20–40% of their annual revenue**.

But the reality is that by the time November rolls around, the game is already decided.

Why?

- **Ad costs explode** - Meta CPMs jump 50%, Google CPCs can double or triple.

- **Competition is brutal** - Every brand is screaming into the same inboxes and chasing the same shoppers.

- **Cold traffic is skeptical** - In a world where everyone’s been hit with endless “SALE” emails, strangers are far less likely to buy without trust.

The brands that crush Q4 don’t rely on last-minute ad blitzes. They’ve spent Q3 building warm, owned audiences that cost a fraction to reach and convert 5–10x better than cold prospects.

That’s why we’re going to focus on a **two-part strategy**:

- Build high-intent, high-ROI Google Ads targeting specific keywords

- Capture the ad traffic with banger opt-in forms to grow your owned list for Q4

## Part 1 — Build the List Before the Sale

When you wait until November to start acquiring customers, you’re fighting the most expensive, competitive ad market of the year.

Meta CPMs jump 50%, Google CPCs spike, and your acquisition costs can _triple_.

Instead:

- Use August–October to buy leads cheap (40–80¢ clicks vs. $6–8 clicks in November).

- Focus on **email + SMS** lists… owned channels with 41x ROI that don’t get more expensive in Q4.

- Warm them up with educational content so by BFCM, they’re primed to buy.

## Part 2 — Capture High-Intent Traffic the Smart Way

Most brands either skip Google Ads or only target expensive bottom-of-funnel keywords like “buy collagen powder.”

Instead, target top-of-funnel educational searches:

- “How to improve skin after 50” (82¢ CPC)

- “Signs of low testosterone” (under $1 CPC)

- “Natural ways to build muscle after 40” (60–70¢ CPC)

These clicks are cheaper, and with the right lead magnet (guide, quiz, early-access sign-up), they convert into warm leads ready to shop your BFCM sale.

**Bonus:** Create _pre-sale_ pages in October for early access sign-ups… “Get our Black Friday deal 48 hours before everyone else” works like magic.

## Part 3 — Optimize Pop-Ups to Convert 10%+

Your ad dollars are wasted if your pop-up isn’t built to convert.

We’ve found _survey-based pop-ups_ beat generic “Enter your email for 10% off” every time.

Why? Commitment bias - people start with answering an easy question (“What are you shopping for?”), and then they’re more likely to enter their email + SMS.

Best practices:

- Trigger 4–6 seconds after page load

- Make the offer the biggest element (bold, in-your-face)

- Separate email and SMS steps

- Use a full-screen pop-up, not a tiny box

- Hide the close “X” and use “No thanks, I’ll pay full price” instead

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/0e735141-6aa4-4d98-831b-ea47e4bdc887/Screenshot_2025-08-13_at_10.42.40_AM.png?t=1755074566)

Quiz-Based Pop-Up Example

I HIGHLY recommend using Alia for email pop-ups… guarantee they will get you 50-100% more opt-ins minimum and skyrocket your list growth. We use them for almost all our clients. Link to download [Shopify App »](https://apps.shopify.com/alia?mref=max&utm_source=www.inboxnewsletter.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ecommerce-black-friday-cyber-monday-2025-q4-prep)

You can also book a demo call [here](https://www.alialearn.com/demo?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=ecommerce-black-friday-cyber-monday-2025-q4-prep) and for “where did you first hear about us'“ say “Max from Well Copy sent me” and you will get a bonus deal 😉

## Part 4 — Segment & Attack in Q4

When BFCM hits, segment your list into:

- **New Subscribers** – Push first-time buyer offers & social proof.

- **Existing Customers** – Give loyalty perks & bundle deals.

- **High-Value Customers** – Offer VIP exclusives, limited editions.

- **Lapsed Customers** – Use aggressive win-back offers.

Run dedicated Google Ads + email/SMS campaigns for each group.

## Part 5 — Email/SMS Execution for BFCM Week

- Unsuppress old inactive profiles for maximum reach.

- Cycle **three different offers** across Early Access, Black Friday, and Cyber Monday to get repeat purchases.

- Send **2–3 emails/day** and **1–2 SMS/day** — inbox life is short during BFCM.

- Mix in plain-text founder emails to cut through the noise and dodge the spam folder.

**Bottom Line:** If you want to win BFCM, the time to start is now. Every week you wait, those cheap $1–$2 clicks turn into $6–$8 fights for cold traffic that probably won’t convert.

Build the list. Warm the list. Segment the list. Then unleash in Q4.

Watch the full video with Jackson [here »](https://youtu.be/iBg8j_U_6oY?si=b6kvNrpfsSWuQyEb&utm_source=www.inboxnewsletter.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ecommerce-black-friday-cyber-monday-2025-q4-prep)

entries.title: Turn Customer Words Into Conversions: The Review Strategy You’re Not Using
entries.summary: Most ecom brands know they should show reviews… but here’s the problem:
entries.body:
Hey it’s Max from The Inbox Newsletter.

Most ecom brands know they should show reviews… but here’s the problem:

They just slap a random 5-star review in a footer and call it a day…

That’s not how you optimize for conversions.

**Key Takeaways:**

- 93% of customers say online reviews impact their purchase decisions, yet most brands barely use them.

- The _right_ review tackles a pain point or tells a story.

- Use AI tools to mine your reviews for emotional, problem-solving gold.

- Incorporating targeted testimonials into your campaigns can lift conversions by 20%+.

### Why Reviews Are Your Secret Weapon

In a world where customers have been burned by shady online sellers, trust is everything.

- 93% of shoppers say reviews influence what they buy.

- 79% trust online reviews as much as personal recommendations.

- Displaying reviews can increase conversion rates by up to 270%.

We all know this already. Like duh, reviews will help conversiond.

But not all reviews are created equal…

A generic “Love this product!” might make your mom smile, but it won’t close the sale.

The reviews that move the needle are:

- **Pain point focused:** Address the specific hesitation your prospect has (“I thought switching from my nightly wine would be hard… until I tried this.”)

- **Story-based:** Humans are wired to connect through narrative, a customer sharing their journey from frustration to delight makes your product _the hero_.

- **Specific:** Numbers, details, and before/after outcomes make a review credible.

**The "Pain Point Match" Method**

- List your top 3 customer objections (price, switching habits, skepticism about results).

- Search your reviews for stories that specifically overcome each objection.

- Place those reviews directly in the emails, product pages, or ads targeting that concern.

Example: If you’re selling a caffeine alternative, don’t just use “Tastes great!” — find the one that says: “I used to drink 3 coffees a day and crash by 2 PM. Now, I’m steady all day — and sleeping better at night.”

### How to Find Winning Reviews (Without Losing Hours)

No longer do you have to scroll through all the reviews on your website to find the right ones…

You can actually have ChatGPT scan your website’s reviews and pull out testimonials that match specific pain points.

Simple prompt example: “Find reviews from my site that mention giving up coffee, feeling more energy, or better sleep.”

This takes a mountain of review data and turns it into plug-and-play sales copy.

### Themed Testimonial Emails (Brez Style)

The DrinkBrez “Replace Your Nightly Wine” email is a perfect example.

It takes _one_ specific use case, swapping wine for their thc drink, and then builds the whole email around that scenario.

The copy isn’t just “Our customers love us.”

It’s:

- Here’s _why_ someone switched

- Here’s _how_ it solved their problem

- Here’s what _other people just like you_ said about it

This is the difference between a testimonial and a **themed testimonial**.

One is broad and forgettable.

The other feels like it was written _for_ the reader’s exact situation.

If you sell skincare, it could be “What customers say about fixing breakouts before weddings.”

If you sell supplements, it could be “How customers say they stopped their afternoon crash.”

Pick the theme → find 2-3 reviews that live in that world → build the entire email around it.

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/a592b222-02cd-4c8a-84f0-b70e7ef8de34/screencapture-milled-drinkbrez-com-slow-sip-sunday-volume-04-BRQQB-l52K-R0p9z-2025-08-11-11_00_18-edit.png?t=1754903692)

Themed Testimonial Email

entries.title: High Leverage A/B Testing in Ecommerce Email Marketing
entries.summary: Many brands / agencies will change a subject line or button color and call it “optimization.”
entries.body:
Hey it’s Max from The Inbox Newsletter.

Today we’re talking about A/B testing.

Most brands make one of two mistakes with their AB testing…

Mistake #1: They don’t test enough…

Mistake #2: They test the wrong stuff.

Many brands / agencies will change a subject line or button color and call it “optimization.”

The problem is that those kinds of micro-tests rarely make a dent in your bottom line.

If you want to grow fast, you have to test the _big stuff_.

The changes that can swing revenue by double digits overnight and affect _whether or not a customer buys._

**Today I’m sharing 7 recent A/B tests we ran for clients that had a real impact on their results.**

### Test #1: Product Section Content

**Top:** Product section included bullet points of product features and benefits

**Bottom:** Product section included a single, passionate testimonial about the product.

Testimonials resulted in 42% higher placed orders… social proof for the win!

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/97ff9833-5c90-4da1-9312-f2b7f3d9cf0c/Screenshot_2025-08-08_at_12.16.41_PM.png?t=1754648207)

Test #1: Product Section Content

### Test #2: Send Times

**Top:** 12pm send time

**Bottom:** 5pm send time

For this audience it seems that later in the day massively outperforms earlier in the day… resulting in almost double the clicks and placed orders!

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/5f150a15-5785-4e30-a37c-e0bd2d9cbf9b/Screenshot_2025-08-08_at_12.20.16_PM.png?t=1754648421)

Test #2: Send Times

### Test #3: Abandoned Cart Email #1 Content Test

**Top:** Simply showing the abandoned cart and saying the customer forgot something

**Bottom:** Adding icons about shipping info and social proof + information about the brand

It looks like adding in more information and handling objections in your abandonment emails is really important!

Minimal impact on click rate but HUGE impact on conversions… 42% higher conversion rate

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/1bba8817-3872-42ce-969e-518af8e5d0d5/Screenshot_2025-08-08_at_12.21.42_PM.png?t=1754648508)

Test #3: Abandoned Cart Email #1 Content Test

### Test #4: Pop-Up Form Offer

**Top:** $5 OFF (“Sign up for $5 OFF”)

**Bottom:** Mystery Discount (“Sign up for a mystery discount” and they are given $5 OFF)

One of my favorite tests to run…

This brand was skeptical about the mystery discount and wanted the brand to be more straightforward. But he was open to testing.

The results of 15% increase in opt-ins and 150% increase in placed orders changed his mind!

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/4481f3ff-0f9e-4b7c-99c3-9b237ce13a99/Screenshot_2025-08-08_at_12.24.05_PM.png?t=1754648649)

Test #4: Pop-Up Form Offer

### Test #5: Showing Prices of Products

**Top:** Showing the prices of all products in the email

**Bottom:** Hiding prices and just showing the product

For this brand, showing prices resulted in 63% higher clicks and 67% higher placed orders. Will need to test more to be conclusive on these results.

No need to gate keep pricing, customers want to know!

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/fc97e611-560c-4af0-9302-7d18ed0471db/Screenshot_2025-08-08_at_12.27.48_PM.png?t=1754648873)

Test #5: Showing Prices of Products

### Test #6: Plain Text vs Branded Text Email

**Top:** Plain text email… no logos, no footer, just text that shows up like a friend sent you an email

**Bottom:** Branded plain text email. Same copy but logo image at the top and a designed footer.

Plain text for the win! Keeping things simple and personal resulted in 63% more clicks and 76% higher placed order rate!

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/5db4df6d-fc18-4440-a346-22ff03fd4c9f/Screenshot_2025-08-08_at_12.30.46_PM.png?t=1754649052)

Test #6: Plain Text vs Branded Text Email

### Test #7: Winback Email 20% OFF vs $16.42 in Store Credit

**Top:** Plain text email giving 20% OFF to customers with a

**Bottom:** Plain text email giving $16.42 of store credit

Interesting one here with crazy results! Being oddly specific with a discount and making it framed as “Store Credit” resulted in 5.8x higher click rate and 10x higher placed orders!

(Much lower AOV on store credit email… it may be smart to add a minimum order threshold such as $45)

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eeb22579-6f2e-4473-ac89-fe707a26fc2b/Screenshot_2025-08-08_at_12.33.52_PM.png?t=1754649239)

Test #7: Winback Email 20% OFF vs $16.42 in Store Credit

## Do Testing Right!

We don’t just test to say we’re testing.

We are strategizing and running high-leverage levers that directly impact revenue.

Run enough of them, stack the winners, and your email channel becomes a compounding growth machine.

If you want a team running these kinds of experiments for you every week and not just “managing” your emails… book a free strategy call with us.

We’ll show you exactly what we’d test first for your brand and give you a roadmap to start driving more orders _immediately_.

_**[Book a call here »](https://calendly.com/maxwellcopy/discovery-meeting?amp%3Butm_campaign=13)**_

entries.title: The $100M Strategy to Build High-Converting Emails in 2025
entries.summary: But most brands aren’t utilizing these modern strategies well enough.
entries.body:
Hey it’s Max from The Inbox Newsletter.

Non-discount email marketing is easier than ever.

But most brands aren’t utilizing these modern strategies well enough.

Let’s break down what we’re doing to generate $10M/mo+ from email every month.

**Key Takeaways:**

- Ad costs are up, competition is fierce, and customer trust is at an all-time low.

- Making sure you send at the right frequency with the right angles is the biggest driver of your success

- Segment smarter, not smaller. Broad targeting with intent-driven content wins.

- Design and copy must be optimized for conversions.

### The State of the Market in 2025

This isn’t 2020. Here’s what’s changed:

- **Acquisition costs are spiking**. No paid ads aren't dying… they’re just 5x more expensive than before.

- **Customer loyalty is fleeting**. Shoppers bounce between 5–10 brands and are always looking for new options.

- **Trust is everything**. Your audience has been burned before. One bad experience and they’re gone.

- **Impulse is dead**. Sales take multiple touchpoints now. Your job is to create those touchpoints.

Email is the only channel that lets you show up consistently, cheaply, and with full control.

But _how_ you use it in 2025 is the real difference maker.

### How to Create High-Converting Email Calendars

The goal: Turn your email list into a traffic and revenue machine.

**Step 1: Choose your frequency.**

Send **2–4x per week.**

3x/week is the sweet spot… enough to stay top of mind, not enough to burn out your list.

Use the below guide to determine what frequency you should send at:

**Store Revenue**

**Monthly Site Visitors**

**Email Frequency**

$0-50k/mo

0-25k/mo

2x per week

$50k-250k/mo

25k-50k/mo

3x per week

$250k-1M/mo

50k-250k/mo

4x per week

$1M/mo+

250k/mo+

5-6x per week

**Step 2: Rotate through proven frameworks.**
Build around content types that are proven to convert without discounts:

- **Product Education** – Break down a product’s benefits in plain terms.

- **Founder Stories** – Build trust by showing the face behind the brand.

- **Value Stack Offers** – Sell full price using social proof, USPs, and transformation.

- **“How To Use” Guides** – Reduce objections, boost AOV.

- **Customer Highlights / UGC** – Show your product working in the real world.

**Step 3: Use AI To Help Strategize**
Here’s a link to a free custom GPT I’ve trained on creating high converting email calenars and copy. [GPT »](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-676b0bbf8b2c81918fa37c1fedd57069-email-marketing-brain?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=the-100m-strategy-to-build-high-converting-emails-in-2025)

### 3. Segmentation That Actually Works

Please leave hyper-niche segmentation in 2024... In 2025, segmentation should be **strategic, not excessive**.

Use high-leverage segments like:

- **14/30/60/90-day engaged** → keep deliverability high and spam low.

- **VIPs** → high LTV, repeat buyers, or top 10% spenders.

- **Recent website visitors** → send them extra content to get them over the age

The biggest mistake is segmenting so tight you only send to 8,000 out of your 60,000-person list.

That’s how you leave revenue on the table.

You don’t need 20 micro-audiences.

You need 3-5 intentional, LARGE segments and a message that actually resonates.

[Go to page 11 on this doc to get a list of all the segments we use »](https://gamma.app/docs/100M-Email-Campaigns-Strategy-Playbook-For-2025-2026-xbq1oaram3lk496?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=the-100m-strategy-to-build-high-converting-emails-in-2025)

### 4. Copy and Design That Converts

Email design awards don’t pay the bills. Revenue does.

**Copy / Design Principles:**

- Write like a human, not a brochure.

- Keep under 200 words unless you’re telling a story.

- Focus on making emails skimmable, people aren’t reading.

- Keep your messages CLEAR… don’t try to make too many points

- Keep your emails concise, no one wants a brochure of information.

This 35 page doc on non-discount email marketing that I just made breaks this all down with examples. _**[Check it out here »](https://gamma.app/docs/100M-Email-Campaigns-Strategy-Playbook-For-2025-2026-xbq1oaram3lk496?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=the-100m-strategy-to-build-high-converting-emails-in-2025)**_

entries.title: How to Design Emails That Print Money: The $100M Blueprint
entries.summary: In a world where everyone is sending emails, design is what will make you stand out.
entries.body:
Hey it’s Max from The Inbox Newsletter.

In a world where everyone is sending emails, design is what will make you stand out.

The average ecommerce brand settles for basic templates that look like everyone else.

That’s a mistake. Because in email, boring = invisible.

Here’s the no-fluff breakdown of how to design emails that stop the scroll, get the click, and drive revenue like crazy.

**Key Takeaways:**

- Conversion-optimized design can 3x your email revenue.

- Use big, above-the-fold buttons with clear CTAs to remove friction.

- Simplicity, skimmability, and brand consistency are the holy trinity of email design.

- Each section of the email (hero, bridge, product) serves a unique purpose

- Steal from proven design winners. No need to reinvent the wheel.

### 1. Why Email Design Matters More Than Ever

- **Design = Differentiation:** Most brands use the same stale templates. Good design separates your brand from the sea of sameness.

- **Design = Engagement:** Visually engaging emails keep people opening and clicking, which boosts deliverability too.

- **Design = Authority:** Sloppy design signals a low-quality brand. Sharp design builds trust and perceived value.

### 2. The 3 Pillars of High-Converting Design

**1. Ease of Click:**
The best emails make it dead simple to take action. That means big, centered buttons especially for mobile. And those buttons need to live _above the fold_. If someone opens your email and has to scroll to find what they came for (usually a discount or product), you’ve already lost them. Your CTA should be one of the first things they see.

**2. Skimmability:**
No one is reading. Everyone is skimming. So your job is to make it impossible to miss the point. Keep layouts clean. Headlines short. Use visual hierarchy to guide the reader’s eye from image to message to button. Design should make the email easy to digest in five seconds or less.

**3. Brand Consistency:**
Your emails should feel like an extension of your website and your ads. Use the same fonts, color palette, voice, and image style. When every part of your funnel feels connected, conversion rates go up.

### 3. Master the Structure of Your Email

**Hero Section**
This is your opening scene, the part of the email everyone sees. Make it count. Use a bold headline, compelling visual, and a clear CTA button. Your value prop should be obvious within two seconds. Treat it like a mini landing page.

**Bridge Section**
This is the supporting argument. Use it to add context, answer objections, or build trust. USE INFOGRAPHICS. That could mean a quick product benefit list, a customer testimonial, or even a visual showing how your product is used. The goal is to keep the scroll going.

**Product Section**
Every product featured in your email should have its own button. Period. No exceptions. If someone likes what they see, don’t make them go hunt for it. And if they don’t like any of the items you featured, end the section with a broader CTA like “Shop All” to keep them engaged.

**Transitions and Flow**
Emails shouldn’t feel like blocky chunks of content. Use subtle design transitions, like background color shifts or gradients, to help your email flow from one section to the next. It makes the whole experience smoother, and that keeps people scrolling longer.

### 4. One Final Tip: Steal What Works

Study brands with killer design (Casely, Magic Spoon, Olipop) and take what works. Use tools like:

- [Milled](https://milled.com/?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=how-to-design-emails-that-print-money-the-100m-blueprint) – massive archive of ecommerce emails

- [Really Good Emails](https://reallygoodemails.com/?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=how-to-design-emails-that-print-money-the-100m-blueprint) – curated examples from top brands

**Further Resource:** Here’s a video of me going through bad email designs and good email designs. This will give you all you need to know. _**[Watch Video »](https://youtu.be/KbZF3qPz51s?si=FxQGSNOGjwQ46ed1&utm_source=www.inboxnewsletter.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=how-to-design-emails-that-print-money-the-100m-blueprint)**_

entries.title: How Obvi Built a Profitable $40M/yr Funnel For Their Ecommerce Brand (And What You Can Steal)
entries.summary: You ever see a brand printing money and wonder: How are they doing this?!
entries.body:
Hey it’s Max from The Inbox Newsletter.

You ever see a brand printing money and wonder: _How are they doing this?!_

I do…

Obvi scaled to $40M/year with one of the cleanest, sharpest funnels I’ve ever seen.

I broke it down, here’s how to rip it.

**Key Takeaways:**

- Obvi runs 170+ ad creatives using AI graphics to test cheap, scalable static ads and combining them with video UGC ads.

- Their acquisiitoin offer gives people over 50% OFF

- Their optimized pop-up form is engineered to stop scrolls, collect emails/phones, and build buyer intent.

- A robust email/SMS welcome flow delivers daily urgency and helps nurture cold leads to purchase

## Obvi and Their Funnel

[Obvi](http://myobvi.com/?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=how-obvi-built-a-profitable-40m-yr-funnel-for-their-ecommerce-brand-and-what-you-can-steal) is a DTC collagen supplement brand built on one thing: hyper-efficient customer acquisition.

Their target are middle aged women who are looking to lose weight.

There are a couple of key things of their funnel that we need to break down.

Hopefully you learn a thing or two.

## 1. Meta Ad Creative Volume

Obvi currently runs 170 ads on Meta.

Half are static AI graphics which are cheap and fast to test/scale.

The other half are UGC videos which likely do a lot of the converting.

Make sure you have a mix of different ads in your account and are utilizing scalable ways to test graphics / headlines such as AI.

Every ad uses the same caption, which means they have probably tested the shit out of it and it’s a proven winner lol.

**I’ll attach their winning caption below for you:**

_“Over 500,000 women trust this Collagen Infused 3-Step System to help tackle their weight loss goals 24/7!_

_☀️ Morning Boost - Kickstart Your Metabolism & Energy_
_⚡ Afternoon Support - Crush Your Cravings & Stay Focused_
😴 _Evening Burn - Restful Sleep & Overnight Calorie Burn_
🔋 _Powered by 5 Types of Collagen & Patented Ingredients_

_“I’ve tried everything! Calorie counting, crash diets, fasting, you name it. Nothing worked until the Burn Box. Within the first week, my cravings were gone, I had way more energy, and I actually started seeing the scale move. I’ve lost 17 pounds so far and my jeans finally fit again. Best part? I didn’t have to starve myself to get here.”_

_Obvi has a 90 Day Money Back Guarantee. If you don't love your results get your money back no questions asked!”_

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/3da980b3-b1ba-4e77-b5dc-daff67687910/Screenshot_2025-07-30_at_9.25.06_AM.png?t=1753860312)

Ads in Account

## 2. Banger Acquisition Offer + Landing Page That Does the Selling

Every ad sends to a **dedicated acquisition landing page** (not just a general home page) meant to convert customers.

It pitches a 30-, 60-, or 90-day collagen supply with _tiered_ discounting (50%, 58%, 61%).

Yes, you read that right… **THEY OFFER 50% OFF AS THEIR LOWEST OFFER** 🤯

Here’s the landing page link [here »](https://myobvi.com/pages/obvi-burn-box-bundle?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=how-obvi-built-a-profitable-40m-yr-funnel-for-their-ecommerce-brand-and-what-you-can-steal)

Two headlines are always in rotation that they are testing. "Burn Fat 24/7” vs “3x Faster To Slim”

This page is pure conversion science: bold benefits, offer stacking, clear CTAs.

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/9b40386f-a88f-4387-8e61-5104429ca3a5/Screenshot_2025-07-30_at_9.31.49_AM.png?t=1753860715)

Banger Acquisition Offer

### 3. Pop-Up Psychology Mastery

This might be my favorite part.

They hide this pop-up on the acquisition page to keep users focused on the 50% off acquisition offer.

But nobody buys immediately when they visit the site…

So on all other pages on the site when the customer inevitably comes back, they trigger this pop-up form granting an extra 20-25% OFF.

**This will allow Obvi to send emails and text messages to get the customer to convert, which are much much cheaper than running retargeting ads.**

- Users get a full-screen pop-up which always converts better.

- The X is hidden for the first second of the form (a small trick that increases engagement).

- They ask a question first to get commitment from the user, which almost always converts better

- They seperate asking for email and sms

- Use strong CTAs directly stating the offer

A really cool addition to the experience that no one else does…

Is adding this educational slide show on steps 5-8 which lasts 15 seconds but really warms the customer up.

If the customer goes through it they get an elevated discount of 25% OFF.

Awesome stuff.

But still… **users don’t just convert off a pop-up form…**

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/88345762-2941-4239-b35d-f3d08ec05dd7/Screenshot_2025-07-30_at_9.33.31_AM.png?t=1753860817)

Pop-Up Experience

### 4. Email + SMS That Closes the Sale

Their email and sms welcome flows off of the pop-up are aggressive in the best way:

- One email and one SMS per day for 5 days

- Every email leads with the offer and a CTA at the top

- After the third email, they bump the discount to 25%

- Final emails use heavy urgency (expiring soon, limited-time)

SMS mirrors this strategy. Short, punchy, daily texts. Satisfaction guarantees + urgency drive the finish.

Why so aggressive?

When someone first enters their information, this is the HOTTEST THEY WILL EVER BE.

They would rather OVERSEND and convert as many people as possible in this high-conversion window... rather than risk sending too little, the customer loses interest, and goes with a competitor.

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/a62c1a70-fefd-405f-9ad6-1ca3da4b2edc/Screenshot_2025-07-30_at_9.37.45_AM.png?t=1753861071)

Email Welcome Flow

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/3742e9ca-200f-4b3b-bdc4-f8ab9956a61e/Screenshot_2025-07-30_at_9.37.58_AM.png?t=1753861082)

SMS Welcome Flow

### 5. Key Takeaways For Your Brand

To steal this strategy:

- **Create a killer acquisition offer** and build a dedicated landing page for ads

- **Engineer your pop-up** to get both emails and phone numbers with intent-based steps

- **Fire daily emails and SMS** for 5 days post-opt-in with urgency, clarity, and conversion design

This funnel is profit-first, data-backed, and scalable.

Study it. Implement pieces. Profit more.

[_**You can keep the file breaking it all down here »**_](https://www.figma.com/design/P4mfpmmxW5F96ObZDW7piz/Obvi?node-id=1-101&t=Cn8PJT3w7ZmciNTX-1&utm_source=www.inboxnewsletter.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=how-obvi-built-a-profitable-40m-yr-funnel-for-their-ecommerce-brand-and-what-you-can-steal)

At my agency, Well Copy, we help brands build profitable funnels like Obvi.

We’ve helped over 200 brands build similar funnels and do over $100M in revenue.

If you want a custom roadmap of how we can build a system like this for you, [book a free consultation here »](https://calendly.com/maxwellcopy/discovery-meeting?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=how-obvi-built-a-profitable-40m-yr-funnel-for-their-ecommerce-brand-and-what-you-can-steal)

entries.title: Your Black Friday Success Starts Right Now (Not in November)
entries.summary: Let me be clear: If you’re not already prepping for BFCM, you’re behind.
entries.body:
Hey it’s Max from The Inbox Newsletter.

Let me be clear: If you’re not already prepping for BFCM, you’re behind.

Because once Q4 hits, everything gets more expensive… and way more competitive.

Here’s what smart brands are doing right now to win Black Friday week.

**Key Takeaways:**

- Q4 ad costs are going to skyrocket… get ahead now by building your list while traffic is still cheap.

- Optimize your pop-up forms for max conversions before the storm hits.

- Fix your deliverability now so you’re _in the inbox_ when it matters most.

- Start collecting SMS numbers today, text is king during BFCM.

- Use _three offers_… Early Access, Black Friday week, and Cyber Monday for max results.

## I Want You To Start Thinking About BFCM Now

You can never be too early to start prepping for BFCM.

For many brands, if you f*ck up your Q4 you’ve f*cked up your whole year.

Follow these practices to make sure you don’t flop this year.

### Build Your List Now (While It’s Still Cheap)

Paid traffic is only getting more expensive through then end of the year.

By November, you’ll be paying 50%+ more per click for the same eyeballs.

That’s why the _real_ BFCM prep starts with list growth _today_.

Dial in your pop-up forms.

Even just jumping from 3% opt-ins to to 6% opt-ins could double your email revenue.

If you’re already at 10% opt-ins for your pop-up… that doesn’t mean stop now.

Taking your form from 10% to 12% may not seem like a lot but that is 20% increase in your list growth and potentially thousands extra during BFCM.

Need help? This [pop-up training guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zw7qW6cp4Kk&utm_source=www.inboxnewsletter.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=your-black-friday-success-starts-right-now-not-in-november) breaks it all down.

### Fix Your Deliverability or Get Buried

The fastest way to make more during BFCM is just to land in the _main inbox_.

Landing in the main inbox takes time to build that reputation.

Start now by warming up your list:

- Send only to 60 day engaged segments

- Focus on high-click, text-based emails

- Clean your list monthly and remove people unengaging

Be careful with any send to your whole list.

You should be getting 50% opens on all your campaigns before blasting your emails to your whole list in BFCM.

### Start Collecting SMS Numbers Immediately

98% open rates. 5-minute response time.

SMS marketing _crushes_ during Black Friday weekend.

But here’s the thing… you can’t wait until November to start collecting numbers.

Start now. Build your SMS list like it’s your biggest revenue lever.

Because come BFCM, it will be.

Even if you don’t have an SMS program… start it now. May as well.

### Structure 3 Offers Now — Not 1

Don’t just run a “Black Friday Sale” and call it a day.

Split it into three distinct campaigns:

- **Early Access** – Early offer to get initial buyers.

- **Black Friday Week** – Your biggest push and strongest offer

- **Cyber Monday** – Final chance with a twist

This gives you 3x the urgency, 3x the hype, and 3x the chances to convert.

But for the love of email… don’t do that nonsense where you start Black Friday 3 weeks early. It kills excitement.

People want NEW… so structure 3 different offers so you can have 3 “LAST CHANCE” pushes.

All the best BFCM brands have multiple offers for different times.

### Final Word

BFCM isn't a single weekend.

It’s a _season_ that starts right now if you want to win it.

Your ads will get more expensive. Your competition will panic.

But if your list is warmed, your pop-ups have been optimized, and your offers are ready… You’ll print cash.

Let’s make Q4 your best ever.

If you want to have a team on top of all this for you, book a call with us.

We’ll run an audit of your email account and build you a Q4 roadmap. [Book a call »](https://calendly.com/maxwellcopy/discovery-meeting?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=your-black-friday-success-starts-right-now-not-in-november)

entries.title: Ecommerce Email Marketing Segmentation That Actually Works
entries.summary: There’s one tactic that improves deliverability, increases revenue, AND protects your list health…
entries.body:
Hey it’s Max from The Inbox Newsletter.

There’s one tactic that improves deliverability, increases revenue, AND protects your list health…

It’s segmentation. But not the “segment by their favorite color” kind…

## The Segments That Actually Matter

DO NOT OVERCOMPLICATE IT.

You don’t need 20 segments. Just a handful of smart, strategic ones.

Too many segments → Too much overwhelm → Worse results

Keep it simple. Just use the following…

**Segment Name**

**Segment Definition**

**Segment Use Case**

**90 Day Engaged List**

(You can use any time frame, 90 is recommended to start)

Someone can receive email marketing because person is subscribed
**AND**

Someone has Opened Email at least once in the last 90 days
**OR**

Someone has been Active on Site at least once in the last 90 days
**OR**

Someone has Placed An Order at least once in the last 90 days

This is your base segment for sending all your email campaigns to.

We want to only send emails to our active subscribers so we keep high open rates and click rates.

If we send to unengaged people they will hurt our engagement rates, Google will notice, and we will land more often in the spam folder.

**High-Potential Purchasers**

Someone can receive email marketing because person is subscribed
**AND**

Someone has placed order 0 times in the past 30 days
**AND**

Someone has been active on site at least once in the past 30 days

For sending 1x-2x extra emails per month (on top of engaged list sends)

This list is a set of people who have been active on your site and have made it somewhere in the funnel but haven't made a purchase.

You can send them more emails to try to get them over the edge and increase your sales.

**Winback Potential Customers**

(Time frames will vary based on your store and how soon people typically come back)

Someone can receive email marketing because person is subscribed
**AND**

Someone has placed order at least once in the past 150 days
**AND**

Someone has placed order zero times in the last 90 days

For sending 1x extra email per month (on top of engaged list sends) OR triggering into a Winback email flow.

This list is exclusive to people who have bought a certain period of time ago but haven't purchased recently.

The amount of time is going to vary based on the store and the average buying period in between purchases.

For this group you will want a few flow emails to fire when they enter the segment encouraging them to come back and make another purchase. It may be a good idea to send them a discount as well.

**VIP Customers**

(This will again vary on store, use your gut on what counts as a VIP customer)

Someone can receive email marketing because person is subscribed
**AND**

Someone has placed order at least 4 times over all time

For sending 1x extra emails per month (on top of engaged list sends) AND/OR triggering into an email flow

This segment is pretty self explanatory.

These are your customers who are fans of your brand and keep coming back.

You can choose to make your VIP list either on their total number or purchases with you or total amount spent at your store.

I prefer total number of purchases because you can predict it a little better and send emails to people every purchase letting them know how many purchases they are away from the VIP list.

It's a good idea to have a simple VIP email flow to anybody who joins this segment thanking them, giving some exclusive content, and giving a generous offer.

On top of this, it may be smart to send a VIP email once a quarter with an exclusive deal or offer.

**Interested in X Product / Category**

(You can replace "category" in this segment with "product" if you choose)

Someone can receive email marketing because person is subscribed
**AND**

Someone has viewed item where category is [category] at least once over all time.
**OR**

Someone has added item to cart where category is [category] at least once over all time.
**OR**

Someone has started checkout with item where collection is [collection] at least once over all time.
**OR**

Someone has placed order with item where collection is [collection] at least once over all time.

This is a list of people who have had any interest in a specific product / category in your store that you set.

This list can be great to send targeted sales, announcements, or releases related to the item(s) you have.

You can do this for both products or specific categories, you just have to customize the filter on the segment definition to choose either "product" or "category".

**Suppress List**

Someone can receive email marketing because person is subscribed
**AND**

Someone has received email at least 5 times over all time
**AND**

Someone has opened email zero times in the last 365 days
**OR**

Someone has bounced email at least 3 times over all time
**OR**

Someone has marked email as spam at least once over all time

For not sending ANY emails to

This is an email segment of people that aren't engaging with your emails and / or are high risk email profiles that don't deserve to be sent emails.

You should be looking at this once a month and suppressing these profiles to save money on your Klaviyo bill, which will charge based on your email profiles.

### Results From Sending to Majority 90 Day Engaged

Yes, you could hyper segment your list by their favorite color and if their belly button is an innie or an outie…

And yes, that would probably increase your conversion rate if you send emails specific to them…

**But at what cost?**

Would you rather send 1-2 targeted campaigns per week to different email groups of 10,000 people OR 3-4 broader email campaigns per week to 50,000 people each?

The latter will outperform 99 times out of 100.

Yes, you should segment based on engagement… but don't get carried away and distracted from the basics.

Just look at the results below where we majority just send to the 90-day engaged… the results speak for themself.

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/75c51e9b-fc82-4dc0-a6b7-190840c036bb/Screenshot-2025-07-11-at-12.43.11-PM.png?t=1753441287)

Results Example #1

Results Example #2

entries.title: The 5 Email Marketing Lessons That Took Me From “Cool Copy” to $100M in Sales
entries.summary: I was thinking about what to write my newsletter about today and I started thinking about my early email marketing days.
entries.body:
Hey it’s Max from The Inbox Newsletter.

I was thinking about what to write my newsletter about today and I started thinking about my early email marketing days.

When I was a freelancer working in-house as the head email marketer for three different 8-figure brands.

I remember 5 distinct “ah-ha” moments working in these companies that changed the way I think about email marketing.

Today, I want to share those moments with you.

**Key Takeaways:**

- Simplicity beats complexity: one clear message per email wins.

- Email is the core and backbone of high-revenue ecommerce brands

- Focus on the 80/20 of email: popup, flows, and weekly campaigns.

- Double your popup conversion rate and you can double your revenue.

- Great deliverability = send to your engaged list + send good content.

### 1. The Most Underrated Copy Principle in Email: Keep It Simple

Early in my email marketing career, I wrote long, “wizard-level” value bombs that nobody read.

Meanwhile, a new copywriter was sending super short, base-level emails… and crushing me on clicks and revenue.

The difference?

He kept things skimmable and to-the-point.

Your customer’s attention span is fried. They're checking emails in traffic or at the grocery store. They want quick dopamine, not a novel.

**Takeaway:** Focus each email on one idea and hand off the CTA like it’s a silver platter.

### 2. Email Is the Backbone of Every 8-Figure Brand

When I worked in-house with 8-figure brands, I saw this pattern everywhere: The email calendar was built first… before ad creatives, social content, even product launches.

One brand spent six figures monthly on ads _just_ to grow their email list. Why? Because email converts cheaper, faster, and better.

**Lesson:** If you aren’t treating email as your growth engine, you’re leaving massive money on the table.

### 3. You’re Overcomplicating It

Most brands stall out with email because they overthink it.

Deliverability, design, segmentation... all of it.

But when we helped a brand hit $750k/month from email/SMS, we didn’t do anything fancy. We just nailed:

- A high-converting popup

- All 8 core email flows

- 3–4 weekly campaigns

And it worked.

**Remember:** Simple systems done well > fancy systems done inconsistently.

### 4. Your Popup Form Might Be the Biggest Revenue Lever

Most brands have a 2-3% popup conversion rate.

We regularly push that to **6-12%**.

One tweak took a client from 750 signups/month to 2,625.

Welcome flow revenue jumped from $7k to $25k/mo… _without changing a single email._

**Tip:** Test new copy, offers, and layouts weekly until your popup is a conversion machine.

**Takeaway:** You may be spending time optimzing the wrong things. Focus on your pop-up and list growth.

### 5. Deliverability Is Easy (If You Know This)

You’re scared of the spam folder, but it’s not that deep.

Google looks at your engagement. If you get 20% opens, they think 80% of people don’t care and they will start sending your stuff to spam.

Fix your deliverability by:

- Only sending to people who open your emails (your 60–120 day engaged segments… anybody who has opened in email in the past 60-120 days)

- Actually sending good content (tips, stories, useful info—not just discounts)

The last part is underrated… **SEND GOOD CONTENT**

If you send fun, entertaining emails, people will keep opening your emails and improve your deliverability.

Many people forget this.

In summary… keep things simple, focus on your pop-up, create good content, and send all emails only to people actively opening your email.

That’s the formula for a solid email system.

entries.title: How to Reduce Your Klaviyo Bill (and Still Make More Money from Email)
entries.summary: You could be spending too much on your Klaviyo bill right now.
entries.body:
Hey it’s Max from The Inbox Newsletter.

You could be spending too much on your Klaviyo bill right now.

Let’s put some money back in your wallet.

**Key Takeaways:**

- Most ecommerce brands are overpaying for Klaviyo without realizing it.

- Suppressing unengaged profiles can save hundreds, sometimes thousands, every month.

- Suppressing the right profiles using the right segments will also boost deliverability and ROI from email.

### Why Most Brands Are Overpaying

Here’s the problem: Klaviyo charges your account based on your number of _active profiles._

An “active profile” is anybody who you can send emails to… by default, every profile in your list is active unless you “suppress” them inside your account.

So, if you have 100,000 people in your account, but only 40,000 are actively engaging with your emails?

You're burning money every month on the remaining 60,000 people who aren't even opening your emails.

### Saving $915/Month Using This Strategy

I know firsthand how much you brand owners hate your Klaviyo bill.

By far, the most appreciated part of our service is how we are monthly optimizing our clients’ Klaviyo bills.

**Us:** “We generated $200k from email this month!”

**Client:** “Cool.”

**Us:** “We also saved you $915 on your Klaviyo bill!”

**Client:** “DBUIWNDIOUNWCIONWIODNWO”

^average client interaction lol

**Example:**

![](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/18cee562-06d9-4d05-9d37-bf560386c73b/GvkXguxXEAA03yP.jpeg?t=1752672266)

By auditing and suppressing unengaged profiles, **we immediately slashed their Klaviyo bill by $915/month within a couple weeks** of working with us.

That’s over **$10,000 per year of profit… saved.**

And deliverability? It _actually improved._ Removing unegaged people → Better open rates. More clicks. More cash.

### How You Can Start Saving Today

Here’s a suppression segment you can copy-paste right now into Klaviyo:

**Segment Name:** Suppress - Unengaged 300 Day

- Person can receive email because person is subscribed

- Opened Email zero times in the last 300 days

- AND Clicked Email zero times in the last 300 days

- AND Placed Order zero times in the last 300 days

- AND Ordered Product zero times in the last 300 days

- AND Received Email is at least 10 over all time

This filters out people who’ve been given more than enough chances to engage and just haven’t.

They’re dead weight and they’re draining your wallet.

**Steps to suppress these profiles:**

- Create the above segment and wait for the segment to populate all profiles.

- Convert the segment to a “list”

- Download the list as a CSV

- Go to the “Profiles” tab in Klaviyo

- Click “View Suppressed Profiles” in the top right part of the screen

- Click “Import”

- Manually drag in your suppression list

**Steps to lower your Klaviyo bill:**

- Go to settings in Klaviyo

- Click “Billing”

- Click “Change Plan”

- Lower yourself to the lowest plan they allow you to

**Less Bloat = More Profit**

Suppressing these profiles won’t hurt your revenue. It’ll help it.

Here’s what happens when you suppress the unengaged:

- Lower sending costs

- Higher deliverability

- Better inbox placement

- Increased engagement

- And, yes, lower Klaviyo bills 🎉

**Stop paying for ghosts.**

Clean your list.

Watch your costs drop and your performance rise.

Need help doing this right? We’ll handle it for you. Book a call with our team **[here](https://calendly.com/maxwellcopy/discovery-meeting?amp%3Butm_medium=referral&amp%3Butm_campaign=how-to-reduce-your-klaviyo-bill-and-still-make-more-money-from-email)**.
